spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m4p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Drones, Ctrl, QCap, Credits, NoDrone

VARIABLES pending, queue, air, credit, logged

vars == <<pending, queue, air, credit, logged>>

\* Each controller queues its own drones, but the credit pool is shared,
\* so one busy controller throttles the other instead of flooding the relay.

Queued == UNION { { queue[i][k] : k \in 1..Len(queue[i]) } : i \in Ctrl }

TypeOK ==
  /\ pending \subseteq Drones
  /\ logged \subseteq Drones
  /\ air \in [Ctrl -> Drones \cup {NoDrone}]
  /\ credit \in 0..Credits
  /\ queue \in [Ctrl -> Seq(Drones)]

Init ==
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ queue = [i \in Ctrl |-> << >>]
  /\ air = [i \in Ctrl |-> NoDrone]
  /\ credit = Credits
  /\ logged = {}

Idle(d) == /\ d \notin pending
           /\ d \notin Queued
           /\ d \notin logged
           /\ \A i \in Ctrl : air[i] # d

Sense(d) ==
  /\ Idle(d)
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, air, credit, logged>>

Admit(i, d) ==
  /\ d \in pending
  /\ credit > 0
  /\ Len(queue[i]) < QCap
  /\ queue'   = [queue EXCEPT ![i] = Append(@, d)]
  /\ credit'  = credit - 1
  /\ pending' = pending \ {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<air, logged>>

\* Keying is guarded on the whole relay, not just this controller's slot.
Uplink(i) ==
  /\ queue[i] # << >>
  /\ \A j \in Ctrl : air[j] = NoDrone
  /\ air' = [air EXCEPT ![i] = Head(queue[i])]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, queue, credit, logged>>

Downlink(i) ==
  /\ air[i] # NoDrone
  /\ logged' = logged \cup {air[i]}
  /\ queue'  = [queue EXCEPT ![i] = Tail(@)]
  /\ air'    = [air EXCEPT ![i] = NoDrone]
  /\ credit' = credit + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED pending

Requeue(i) ==
  /\ queue[i] # << >>
  /\ air[i] = NoDrone
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {Head(queue[i])}
  /\ queue'   = [queue EXCEPT ![i] = Tail(@)]
  /\ credit'  = credit + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<air, logged>>

Rearm(d) ==
  /\ d \in logged
  /\ logged' = logged \ {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pending, queue, air, credit>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Sense(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Rearm(d)
  \/ \E i \in Ctrl, d \in Drones : Admit(i, d)
  \/ \E i \in Ctrl : Uplink(i)
  \/ \E i \in Ctrl : Downlink(i)
  \/ \E i \in Ctrl : Requeue(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Intent: the relay is the critical resource; queue depth and credits may
\* drift, but two controllers must never be on the air together.
OneVoiceOnTheRelay ==
  \A i, j \in Ctrl : (air[i] # NoDrone /\ air[j] # NoDrone) => i = j

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Drones = {dr1, dr2, dr3}
  Ctrl = {north, south}
  QCap = 2
  Credits = 2
  NoDrone = nodrone

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT OneVoiceOnTheRelay
nl:
A wildfire surveillance swarm is flown by two independent ground controllers, north and south. Each controller keeps its own bounded dispatch queue of drones waiting to stream imagery, but both controllers draw from a single shared pool of transmit credits, and there is exactly one physical relay channel that carries a drone feed to the incident command post.

A drone that is not already pending, queued, streaming, or logged may report a new sighting, which puts it in the pending set. Either controller may admit a pending drone into its own queue, but only while a transmit credit is free and that controller's queue is below its capacity; admitting consumes one credit from the shared pool. A controller may key the relay for the drone at the head of its queue only when the relay is idle for both controllers. Once a keyed drone's imagery has been taken, the controller logs the drone, drops it from the head of its queue, unkeys the relay, and returns the credit to the shared pool. A controller may also requeue: if its queue is non-empty and it is not currently keyed, it can push the head drone back to pending and return that drone's credit, which is how a controller sheds load when the shared pool runs dry for the other side.

Finally, a logged drone may be rearmed: it is dropped from the logged set and becomes eligible to report a fresh sighting on its next pass.

SAFETY PROPERTY: At no reachable state are two different controllers keyed onto the relay channel at the same time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m7p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cars, MaxCap, NoSnap

VARIABLES book, stamp, snap, view, filed, cap

vars == <<book, stamp, snap, view, filed, cap>>

NumCars == Cardinality(Cars)

Holders == {i \in Cars : snap[i] # NoSnap}

\* Each car reads the hall-call ledger into a private view, then swaps its
\* merged view back only if the stamp it read is still the live one.

TypeOK ==
  /\ book \subseteq Cars
  /\ filed \subseteq Cars
  /\ stamp \in 0..NumCars
  /\ snap \in [Cars -> (0..NumCars) \cup {NoSnap}]
  /\ view \in [Cars -> SUBSET Cars]
  /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ book = {}
  /\ stamp = 0
  /\ snap = [i \in Cars |-> NoSnap]
  /\ view = [i \in Cars |-> {}]
  /\ filed = {}
  /\ cap = 1

Read(i) ==
  /\ i \notin filed
  /\ snap[i] = NoSnap
  /\ Cardinality(Holders) < cap
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![i] = stamp]
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![i] = book]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<book, stamp, filed, cap>>

\* The swap writes back the whole merged view, so a stale swap would erase
\* every batch filed since the read -- the stamp guard is what forbids it.
Swap(i) ==
  /\ snap[i] # NoSnap
  /\ snap[i] = stamp
  /\ book'  = view[i] \cup {i}
  /\ stamp' = stamp + 1
  /\ snap'  = [snap EXCEPT ![i] = NoSnap]
  /\ view'  = [view EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
  /\ filed' = filed \cup {i}
  /\ UNCHANGED cap

Retry(i) ==
  /\ snap[i] # NoSnap
  /\ snap[i] # stamp
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![i] = NoSnap]
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<book, stamp, filed, cap>>

\* Cars are taken in and out of service while the bank is running; a car
\* holding a view beyond the new limit gives it up untouched.
Shed(i) ==
  /\ snap[i] # NoSnap
  /\ Cardinality(Holders) > cap
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![i] = NoSnap]
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<book, stamp, filed, cap>>

Resize ==
  /\ cap' \in (1..MaxCap) \ {cap}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<book, stamp, snap, view, filed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Cars : Read(i)
  \/ \E i \in Cars : Swap(i)
  \/ \E i \in Cars : Retry(i)
  \/ \E i \in Cars : Shed(i)
  \/ Resize

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ \A i \in Cars : SF_vars(Read(i))
  /\ \A i \in Cars : SF_vars(Swap(i))
  /\ \A i \in Cars : WF_vars(Retry(i))

\* Intent: once a car's batch has been filed it must still be readable in
\* the ledger; a lost update shows up as a filed car missing from book.
NoLostBatch == filed \subseteq book

LedgerCompletes == <>(filed = Cars)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Cars = {carA, carB, carC}
  MaxCap = 3
  NoSnap = nosnap

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT NoLostBatch

PROPERTY LedgerCompletes
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper keeps one shared hall-call ledger recording which cars have filed their accumulated batch of floor requests. Each car updates the ledger through a compare-and-swap register: the ledger carries a stamp that is bumped on every successful write.

A car that has not yet filed reads the ledger, taking a private copy of the ledger contents and of the current stamp, but only while the number of cars currently holding a copy is below the bank's live concurrency limit. A car holding a copy swaps its merged copy -- its own view plus its own batch -- back into the ledger, but only if the stamp it read is still the live stamp; a successful swap bumps the stamp, marks that car as filed, and discards the car's copy. If the stamp has moved on since the read, the car retries: it throws its copy away and goes back for a fresh read. The bank's concurrency limit itself changes while the bank is running: a resize picks a different limit, and a car holding a copy when the number of holders exceeds the new limit sheds that copy without writing anything to the ledger.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every car that has been marked as filed still appears in the ledger, so no successful write is ever erased by a later one.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every car in the bank eventually files its batch, so the ledger eventually records all of them.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m4p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Surgeons, Rooms, MaxTerm, Intake, NoCase

VARIABLES pool, live, term, assign, done

vars == <<pool, live, term, assign, done>>

\* The intake pool is an unordered bag of booking slips, so the scheduler may
\* pick them up in any order -- a slip carries the credential term it was cut
\* under, which is how a slip that outlived its author's privileges is spotted.

Slip == [sg : Surgeons, tm : 0..MaxTerm]

Current(r) == live[r.sg] /\ r.tm = term[r.sg]

TypeOK ==
  /\ pool \subseteq Slip
  /\ live \in [Surgeons -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ term \in [Surgeons -> 0..MaxTerm]
  /\ assign \in [Rooms -> Slip \cup {NoCase}]
  /\ done \subseteq Surgeons

Init ==
  /\ pool = {}
  /\ live = [s \in Surgeons |-> TRUE]
  /\ term = [s \in Surgeons |-> 0]
  /\ assign = [rm \in Rooms |-> NoCase]
  /\ done = {}

\* Intake is bounded; when it is full the desk stops taking slips at all.
Submit(s) ==
  /\ live[s]
  /\ Cardinality(pool) < Intake
  /\ [sg |-> s, tm |-> term[s]] \notin pool
  /\ pool' = pool \cup {[sg |-> s, tm |-> term[s]]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<live, term, assign, done>>

Wheel(rm, r) ==
  /\ assign[rm] = NoCase
  /\ r \in pool
  /\ Current(r)
  /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![rm] = r]
  /\ pool'   = pool \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<live, term, done>>

\* Pulling privileges also clears the theatre: a surgeon whose credential is
\* withdrawn cannot be left standing over an open case.
Revoke(s) ==
  /\ live[s]
  /\ \E o \in Surgeons : o # s /\ live[o]
  /\ term[s] < MaxTerm
  /\ live'   = [live EXCEPT ![s] = FALSE]
  /\ term'   = [term EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
  /\ assign' = [rm \in Rooms |->
                  IF assign[rm] # NoCase /\ assign[rm].sg = s
                    THEN NoCase ELSE assign[rm]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, done>>

Reinstate(s) ==
  /\ ~live[s]
  /\ term[s] < MaxTerm
  /\ live' = [live EXCEPT ![s] = TRUE]
  /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, assign, done>>

Close(rm) ==
  /\ assign[rm] # NoCase
  /\ done'   = done \cup {assign[rm].sg}
  /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![rm] = NoCase]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, live, term>>

Purge(r) ==
  /\ r \in pool
  /\ ~Current(r)
  /\ pool' = pool \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<live, term, assign, done>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Surgeons : Submit(s)
  \/ \E rm \in Rooms, r \in pool : Wheel(rm, r)
  \/ \E s \in Surgeons : Revoke(s)
  \/ \E s \in Surgeons : Reinstate(s)
  \/ \E rm \in Rooms : Close(rm)
  \/ \E r \in pool : Purge(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Intent: a theatre in use is always staffed by someone whose credential is
\* live right now and whose slip matches their current term, never by a
\* surgeon who was pulled or whose slip predates a roster change.
OnlyCurrentStaffOperating ==
  \A rm \in Rooms :
    assign[rm] # NoCase =>
      /\ live[assign[rm].sg]
      /\ assign[rm].tm = term[assign[rm].sg]

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Surgeons = {srgA, srgB}
  Rooms = {or1, or2}
  MaxTerm = 2
  Intake = 2
  NoCase = nocase

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT OnlyCurrentStaffOperating
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler books surgeons into theatres from an intake pool of booking slips. The pool is deliberately unordered: slips arrive over a messaging fabric that can deliver them out of order, so the scheduler may pick up any slip in the pool, not the oldest one. Each surgeon has a credential term, and a slip records the term that was in force for its author at the moment it was cut. A slip is current only if its author is credentialed right now and the slip's term still matches that author's term.

A credentialed surgeon may submit a slip, but only while the intake pool is below its bound and that exact slip is not already sitting in the pool; when intake is full the desk refuses new slips outright, which is how backpressure is applied upstream. The scheduler may wheel a case into any free theatre by taking a current slip out of the pool and attaching it to that theatre. Credentials office may revoke a surgeon, provided at least one other surgeon stays credentialed and that surgeon's term has room to advance: revoking drops the surgeon from the credentialed set, advances that surgeon's term, and immediately clears any theatre that surgeon was standing in. The office may also reinstate a surgeon who is not credentialed, which advances that surgeon's term as well, so any slip that surgeon left in the pool is now out of date. Closing a theatre records the surgeon as having completed a case and frees the theatre. Finally, the scheduler may purge any slip in the pool that is no longer current, which is the only way stale slips stop consuming intake capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every theatre that has a case attached is staffed by a surgeon who is credentialed at that moment and whose slip carries that surgeon's current term.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od3m8p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, Lines, Window, MaxPledge, NoBank

VARIABLES gate, pledge, holder, book

vars == <<gate, pledge, holder, book>>

RECURSIVE Total(_, _)
Total(f, S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + Total(f, S \ {x})

Committed == Total(book, Lines)
Pledged   == Total(pledge, Banks)

\* Coarse first, fine second: a bank must hold the batch gate to size its
\* pledge against the remaining window, and only then may it claim a ledger
\* line and hand the gate straight back to the next bank in the queue.

TypeOK ==
  /\ gate \in Banks \cup {NoBank}
  /\ pledge \in [Banks -> 0..MaxPledge]
  /\ holder \in [Lines -> Banks \cup {NoBank}]
  /\ book \in [Lines -> 0..Window]

Init ==
  /\ gate = NoBank
  /\ pledge = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
  /\ holder = [l \in Lines |-> NoBank]
  /\ book = [l \in Lines |-> 0]

TakeGate(b) ==
  /\ gate = NoBank
  /\ pledge[b] = 0
  /\ gate' = b
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pledge, holder, book>>

DropGate(b) ==
  /\ gate = b
  /\ pledge[b] = 0
  /\ gate' = NoBank
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pledge, holder, book>>

\* Sizing happens under the coarse gate so two banks cannot both read the
\* same remaining headroom and both pledge against it.
Reserve(b, v) ==
  /\ gate = b
  /\ pledge[b] = 0
  /\ Committed + Pledged + v =< Window
  /\ pledge' = [pledge EXCEPT ![b] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gate, holder, book>>

ClaimLine(b, l) ==
  /\ gate = b
  /\ pledge[b] > 0
  /\ holder[l] = NoBank
  /\ \A k \in Lines : holder[k] # b
  /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![l] = b]
  /\ gate' = NoBank
  /\ UNCHANGED <<pledge, book>>

Post(b, l) ==
  /\ holder[l] = b
  /\ pledge[b] > 0
  /\ book' = [book EXCEPT ![l] = @ + pledge[b]]
  /\ pledge' = [pledge EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
  /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![l] = NoBank]
  /\ UNCHANGED gate

Cancel(b) ==
  /\ gate = b
  /\ pledge[b] > 0
  /\ pledge' = [pledge EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
  /\ gate' = NoBank
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, book>>

Cutover ==
  /\ gate = NoBank
  /\ Committed > 0
  /\ Pledged = 0
  /\ \A l \in Lines : holder[l] = NoBank
  /\ book' = [l \in Lines |-> 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gate, pledge, holder>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Banks : TakeGate(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : DropGate(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks, v \in 1..MaxPledge : Reserve(b, v)
  \/ \E b \in Banks, l \in Lines : ClaimLine(b, l)
  \/ \E b \in Banks, l \in Lines : Post(b, l)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Cancel(b)
  \/ Cutover

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ \A b \in Banks : WF_vars(Cancel(b))
  /\ \A b \in Banks : \A l \in Lines : WF_vars(Post(b, l))

\* Intent: money already on the book plus money still pledged under the gate
\* must never run past the settlement window, even mid-handover.
WindowNeverOverdrawn == Committed + Pledged =< Window

PledgesSettle == \A b \in Banks : (pledge[b] > 0) ~> (pledge[b] = 0)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Banks = {bkA, bkB}
  Lines = {ln1, ln2}
  Window = 3
  MaxPledge = 2
  NoBank = nobank

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT WindowNeverOverdrawn

PROPERTY PledgesSettle
nl:
An interbank settlement batch is assembled by several member banks against a fixed settlement window: the total value already written to the batch's ledger lines plus the total value currently pledged but not yet written must fit inside that window. Access is two-level. There is one coarse batch gate, and each ledger line has its own fine claim. A bank is assumed to be slow at times but never to fail outright, so a bank that is holding something will always get around to letting it go.

A bank with nothing pledged may take the batch gate when it is free, and may hand it straight back if it decides not to pledge. While holding the gate, a bank sizes a pledge: it picks an amount and takes it only if the amount still fits in the window alongside everything committed and everything already pledged. A bank holding the gate with a live pledge may claim any unclaimed ledger line, provided it is not already holding a line; claiming the line releases the coarse gate immediately, so the gate is never held across the write. A bank holding a line posts its pledge onto that line: the line's balance grows by the pledged amount, the pledge is cleared, and the line is released. A bank holding the gate with a live pledge may instead cancel: the pledge is cleared and the gate released, with nothing written. When the gate is free, nothing is pledged, no line is claimed, and the batch has value on it, a cutover zeroes every ledger line and reopens the window for the next batch.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The value committed to ledger lines plus the value currently pledged by banks never exceeds the settlement window.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every pledge a bank takes is eventually resolved, so no bank is left holding an unsettled pledge forever.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m5p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Planners, Stations, Drones, Slots, Quorum, NoBid, NoDrone, NoSlot

VARIABLES bid, tally, grant, seat

vars == <<bid, tally, grant, seat>>

Offer == [pl : Planners, dr : Drones]

\* Two mission planners run side by side over one pool of orbit slots. Neither
\* trusts the other's view, so a slot is only handed out once a quorum of
\* ground stations has voted for the same offer.

TypeOK ==
  /\ bid \in [Slots -> Offer \cup {NoBid}]
  /\ tally \in [Slots -> SUBSET Stations]
  /\ grant \in [Slots -> Drones \cup {NoDrone}]
  /\ seat \in [Drones -> Slots \cup {NoSlot}]

Init ==
  /\ bid = [s \in Slots |-> NoBid]
  /\ tally = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
  /\ grant = [s \in Slots |-> NoDrone]
  /\ seat = [d \in Drones |-> NoSlot]

Busy(p) == \E t \in Slots : bid[t] # NoBid /\ bid[t].pl = p

Offered(d) == \E t \in Slots : bid[t] # NoBid /\ bid[t].dr = d

Propose(p, s, d) ==
  /\ bid[s] = NoBid
  /\ grant[s] = NoDrone
  /\ seat[d] = NoSlot
  /\ ~Busy(p)
  /\ ~Offered(d)
  /\ bid' = [bid EXCEPT ![s] = [pl |-> p, dr |-> d]]
  /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, seat>>

Endorse(g, s) ==
  /\ bid[s] # NoBid
  /\ g \notin tally[s]
  /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {g}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bid, grant, seat>>

\* A grant is only cut when the ballot is over the line; both planners see the
\* same grant table afterwards, which is what stops a slot going out twice.
Award(s) ==
  /\ bid[s] # NoBid
  /\ grant[s] = NoDrone
  /\ Cardinality(tally[s]) >= Quorum
  /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![s] = bid[s].dr]
  /\ bid' = [bid EXCEPT ![s] = NoBid]
  /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED seat

Abandon(s) ==
  /\ bid[s] # NoBid
  /\ Cardinality(tally[s]) < Quorum
  /\ bid' = [bid EXCEPT ![s] = NoBid]
  /\ tally' = [tally EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, seat>>

TakeOrbit(d, s) ==
  /\ grant[s] = d
  /\ seat[d] = NoSlot
  /\ seat' = [seat EXCEPT ![d] = s]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bid, tally, grant>>

Recall(d) ==
  /\ seat[d] # NoSlot
  /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![seat[d]] = NoDrone]
  /\ seat' = [seat EXCEPT ![d] = NoSlot]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bid, tally>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Planners, s \in Slots, d \in Drones : Propose(p, s, d)
  \/ \E g \in Stations, s \in Slots : Endorse(g, s)
  \/ \E s \in Slots : Award(s)
  \/ \E s \in Slots : Abandon(s)
  \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Slots : TakeOrbit(d, s)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Recall(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Intent: a drone sitting in an orbit slot must be the one that slot was
\* awarded to. Since grant holds a single drone per slot, that rules out the
\* same slot being flown by two drones at once.
NoSlotHandedOutTwice ==
  \A d \in Drones : seat[d] # NoSlot => grant[seat[d]] = d

====
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm is planned by two independent mission planners that share one pool of orbit slots over the fire ground. Neither planner is authoritative, so no slot is handed out on a planner's say-so alone: a ring of ground stations votes, and a slot is only awarded once a quorum of stations has endorsed the same offer.

A planner may put an offer on a free slot -- a slot with no live ballot and no standing grant -- naming a drone that is not currently seated and not already named in another live ballot; a planner may only have one ballot open at a time, so the two planners interleave rather than flooding the pool. Any ground station may endorse a live ballot for a slot once. When a ballot for a slot reaches the quorum and the slot has no standing grant, the slot is awarded to the drone named in the ballot, and the ballot and its endorsements are cleared. A ballot that has not yet reached the quorum may instead be abandoned, clearing the ballot and its endorsements with no grant cut. A drone that is not seated may take the orbit of any slot granted to it. A seated drone may be recalled: it leaves its slot and the slot's grant is torn down, returning the slot to the shared pool.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any drone occupying an orbit slot is the drone that slot's standing grant names, so a slot is never flown by two drones at once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m9p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cars, Floors, MaxEpoch, NoCall, NoCar

VARIABLES epoch, badge, running, calls, keyed

vars == <<epoch, badge, running, calls, keyed>>

\* The dispatch group is versioned: every regrouping bumps the epoch and
\* restamps the cars that stay in the group. A car carrying an old badge is
\* stale and the dispatcher must ignore it until it re-registers.

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ badge \in [Cars -> 0..MaxEpoch]
  /\ running \in [Cars -> Floors \cup {NoCall}]
  /\ calls \subseteq Floors
  /\ keyed \in Cars \cup {NoCar}

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ badge = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
  /\ running = [c \in Cars |-> NoCall]
  /\ calls = {}
  /\ keyed = NoCar

Press(f) ==
  /\ f \notin calls
  /\ calls' = calls \cup {f}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, badge, running, keyed>>

Dispatch(c, f) ==
  /\ badge[c] = epoch
  /\ keyed # c
  /\ running[c] = NoCall
  /\ f \in calls
  /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![c] = f]
  /\ calls' = calls \ {f}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, badge, keyed>>

Arrive(c) ==
  /\ running[c] # NoCall
  /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![c] = NoCall]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, badge, calls, keyed>>

Register(c) ==
  /\ badge[c] # epoch
  /\ running[c] = NoCall
  /\ badge' = [badge EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, running, calls, keyed>>

\* Regrouping parks the car being dropped in the same step it bumps the
\* epoch, so no car is ever left mid-run holding a badge nobody honours.
Regroup(drop) ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ keyed # drop
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ badge' = [c \in Cars |-> IF c = drop THEN badge[c] ELSE epoch + 1]
  /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![drop] = NoCall]
  /\ calls' = IF running[drop] # NoCall
                THEN calls \cup {running[drop]}
                ELSE calls
  /\ UNCHANGED keyed

\* Fire service: the building key overrides the group entirely.
Seize(c) ==
  /\ keyed = NoCar
  /\ keyed' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, badge, running, calls>>

KeyRun(c, f) ==
  /\ keyed = c
  /\ running[c] = NoCall
  /\ f \in calls
  /\ running' = [running EXCEPT ![c] = f]
  /\ calls' = calls \ {f}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, badge, keyed>>

Yield ==
  /\ keyed # NoCar
  /\ running[keyed] = NoCall
  /\ keyed' = NoCar
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, badge, running, calls>>

Next ==
  \/ \E f \in Floors : Press(f)
  \/ \E c \in Cars, f \in Floors : Dispatch(c, f)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Arrive(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Register(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Regroup(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars : Seize(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cars, f \in Floors : KeyRun(c, f)
  \/ Yield

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ \A c \in Cars : \A f \in Floors : SF_vars(Dispatch(c, f))
  /\ \A c \in Cars : WF_vars(Arrive(c))
  /\ \A c \in Cars : SF_vars(Register(c))

\* Intent: a moving car is either badged for the live epoch or is under the
\* fire key. Nothing else gets to answer a call.
NoStaleCarAnswers ==
  \A c \in Cars :
    running[c] # NoCall => (badge[c] = epoch \/ keyed = c)

EveryCallCleared == \A f \in Floors : (f \in calls) ~> (f \notin calls)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Cars = {carA, carB}
  Floors = {fl3, fl9}
  MaxEpoch = 2
  NoCall = nocall
  NoCar = nocar

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT NoStaleCarAnswers

PROPERTY EveryCallCleared
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper runs its cars as a versioned dispatch group. The group carries an epoch number, and each car carries a badge stamped with the epoch it last registered under. A car whose badge does not match the live epoch is stale: the dispatcher will not give it a hall call. Building security also holds a fire-service key that can override the group for one car at a time.

A hall call may be pressed for any floor that is not already waiting. The dispatcher may send an idle car to a waiting floor only if that car's badge matches the live epoch and the car is not under the fire key; the call is then taken off the waiting set. A car that is running arrives, becomes idle, and takes no further part until dispatched again. A car that is idle and carries a stale badge may re-register, taking the live epoch onto its badge. A regrouping bumps the epoch, restamps every car except the one being dropped from the group, parks the dropped car in the same step, and puts the dropped car's call back on the waiting set if it had one; a car currently under the fire key is never the one dropped. Security may seize any car with the fire key when the key is free, may send a keyed car to any waiting floor regardless of the car's badge, and may yield the key once the keyed car is idle. Cars are slow but never broken: an idle car that could take a waiting call will take one, a running car always arrives, and a stale idle car always re-registers eventually.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any car that is running a call either carries a badge matching the live epoch or is the car currently held under the fire-service key.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every hall call that is pressed is eventually cleared from the waiting set.

---- MODULE W4Od3m3p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Banks, Nodes, Wires, Endow, MaxAmt, MaxTerm, NoMsg, NoNode

VARIABLES bal, wire, chief, term, up

vars == <<bal, wire, chief, term, up>>

RECURSIVE Total(_, _)
Total(f, S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + Total(f, S \ {x})

Cash == Endow * 2

Note == [frm : Banks, to : Banks, amt : 1..MaxAmt]

Floating == Total([w \in Wires |-> IF wire[w] = NoMsg THEN 0 ELSE wire[w].amt],
                  Wires)

\* Wires are addressed slots, not a queue: the chief may settle them in any
\* order, and a settlement note sitting on a wire still counts as money.

TypeOK ==
  /\ bal \in [Banks -> 0..Cash]
  /\ wire \in [Wires -> Note \cup {NoMsg}]
  /\ chief \in Nodes \cup {NoNode}
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ up \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ bal = [b \in Banks |-> Endow]
  /\ wire = [w \in Wires |-> NoMsg]
  /\ chief = NoNode
  /\ term = 0
  /\ up = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]

Led == chief # NoNode /\ up[chief]

Draw(b, c, a, w) ==
  /\ Led
  /\ b # c
  /\ wire[w] = NoMsg
  /\ bal[b] >= a
  /\ bal' = [bal EXCEPT ![b] = @ - a]
  /\ wire' = [wire EXCEPT ![w] = [frm |-> b, to |-> c, amt |-> a]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<chief, term, up>>

Apply(w) ==
  /\ Led
  /\ wire[w] # NoMsg
  /\ bal' = [bal EXCEPT ![wire[w].to] = @ + wire[w].amt]
  /\ wire' = [wire EXCEPT ![w] = NoMsg]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<chief, term, up>>

\* A note the new chief cannot vouch for is returned to the drawer rather
\* than dropped -- dropping it would quietly burn money.
Return(w) ==
  /\ Led
  /\ wire[w] # NoMsg
  /\ bal' = [bal EXCEPT ![wire[w].frm] = @ + wire[w].amt]
  /\ wire' = [wire EXCEPT ![w] = NoMsg]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<chief, term, up>>

Elect(n) ==
  /\ up[n]
  /\ chief # n
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ chief' = n
  /\ term' = term + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, wire, up>>

Fail(n) ==
  /\ chief = n
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
  /\ chief' = NoNode
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, wire, term>>

Restart(n) ==
  /\ ~up[n]
  /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, wire, chief, term>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b, c \in Banks, a \in 1..MaxAmt, w \in Wires : Draw(b, c, a, w)
  \/ \E w \in Wires : Apply(w)
  \/ \E w \in Wires : Return(w)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Fail(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Restart(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Intent: failover must not mint or burn value. Whatever the chief does,
\* balances plus notes still riding the wires add up to the opening cash.
CashConserved == Total(bal, Banks) + Floating = Cash

====

CONSTANTS
  Banks = {bnkA, bnkB}
  Nodes = {coord1, coord2}
  Wires = {wireP, wireQ}
  Endow = 2
  MaxAmt = 2
  MaxTerm = 2
  NoMsg = nomsg
  NoNode = nonode

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT CashConserved
nl:
An interbank settlement batch is driven by a small set of coordinator nodes, exactly one of which is the acting chief for the current term. The member banks each open the batch with the same endowment, and value moves between them as settlement notes that ride a fixed set of addressed wires. The wires are addressed slots rather than a queue, so notes can be settled in any order the chief pleases, and a note sitting on a wire is money that has left one bank and not yet reached another.

Only an acting chief that is up may touch value. It may draw a note: an amount is taken off one bank's balance and placed as a note on a free wire naming a different bank as payee. It may apply any note on any wire, crediting the payee and freeing the wire. It may instead return any note on any wire, crediting the drawer back and freeing the wire; returning is what happens to notes a new chief cannot vouch for, and it is deliberately a credit rather than a discard. Any node that is up may be elected chief for the next term while terms remain. The acting chief may fail, going down and leaving the post empty until someone else is elected. A node that is down may restart and become eligible again.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The sum of all bank balances plus the value of every note still riding a wire always equals the total cash the batch opened with.

---- MODULE W4Od0m8p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Teams, Rooms, NoTeam, NoRoom

VARIABLES wing, room, cart, beam, want

vars == <<wing, room, cart, beam, want>>

\* Two levels: the wing desk is the coarse lock a team must hold to be given
\* a theatre, and each theatre is its own fine lock. The wing is handed back
\* the instant a theatre is taken, so the desk is never held during surgery.

TypeOK ==
  /\ wing \in Teams \cup {NoTeam}
  /\ room \in [Rooms -> Teams \cup {NoTeam}]
  /\ cart \in Rooms \cup {NoRoom}
  /\ beam \in [Rooms -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ want \subseteq Teams

Init ==
  /\ wing = NoTeam
  /\ room = [r \in Rooms |-> NoTeam]
  /\ cart = NoRoom
  /\ beam = [r \in Rooms |-> FALSE]
  /\ want = {}

Seated(t) == \E r \in Rooms : room[r] = t

Request(t) ==
  /\ t \notin want
  /\ want' = want \cup {t}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, room, cart, beam>>

TakeWing(t) ==
  /\ wing = NoTeam
  /\ t \in want
  /\ ~Seated(t)
  /\ wing' = t
  /\ UNCHANGED <<room, cart, beam, want>>

DropWing(t) ==
  /\ wing = t
  /\ wing' = NoTeam
  /\ UNCHANGED <<room, cart, beam, want>>

TakeRoom(t, r) ==
  /\ wing = t
  /\ room[r] = NoTeam
  /\ ~Seated(t)
  /\ room' = [room EXCEPT ![r] = t]
  /\ wing' = NoTeam
  /\ want' = want \ {t}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cart, beam>>

FreeRoom(r) ==
  /\ room[r] # NoTeam
  /\ cart # r
  /\ room' = [room EXCEPT ![r] = NoTeam]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, cart, beam, want>>

Dock(r) ==
  /\ cart = NoRoom
  /\ room[r] # NoTeam
  /\ cart' = r
  /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, room, beam, want>>

\* The imaging cart is the one thing the whole wing shares; a theatre may
\* only power the beam while the cart is physically docked in that theatre.
Fire(r) ==
  /\ cart = r
  /\ ~beam[r]
  /\ beam' = [beam EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, room, cart, want>>

Stop(r) ==
  /\ beam[r]
  /\ beam' = [beam EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, room, cart, want>>

Undock(r) ==
  /\ cart = r
  /\ ~beam[r]
  /\ cart' = NoRoom
  /\ UNCHANGED <<wing, room, beam, want>>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Teams : Request(t)
  \/ \E t \in Teams : TakeWing(t)
  \/ \E t \in Teams : DropWing(t)
  \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : TakeRoom(t, r)
  \/ \E r \in Rooms : FreeRoom(r)
  \/ \E r \in Rooms : Dock(r)
  \/ \E r \in Rooms : Fire(r)
  \/ \E r \in Rooms : Stop(r)
  \/ \E r \in Rooms : Undock(r)

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ \A t \in Teams : SF_vars(TakeWing(t))
  /\ \A t \in Teams : \A r \in Rooms : SF_vars(TakeRoom(t, r))
  /\ \A t \in Teams : WF_vars(DropWing(t))
  /\ \A r \in Rooms : WF_vars(Stop(r))
  /\ \A r \in Rooms : SF_vars(Undock(r))
  /\ \A r \in Rooms : SF_vars(FreeRoom(r))

\* Intent: only the theatre the cart is docked in may be imaging. Because the
\* cart sits in one place, that rules out two theatres imaging at once.
CartUsedInOnePlace ==
  \A r \in Rooms : beam[r] => cart = r

EveryTeamSeated == \A t \in Teams : (t \in want) ~> (t \notin want)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Teams = {teamA, teamB}
  Rooms = {orLeft, orRight}
  NoTeam = noteam
  NoRoom = noroom

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT CartUsedInOnePlace

PROPERTY EveryTeamSeated
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler hands theatres out to surgical teams through two levels of locking. The wing desk is a single coarse lock; each theatre is a fine lock of its own. Requests reach the desk over a paging fabric that does not preserve order, so the desk holds an unordered set of outstanding requests and may serve any of them. The wing shares one mobile imaging cart, and the cart's X-ray beam is the resource that must never be in use in two places at once.

A team that has no outstanding request may raise one. A team that is on the request set and is not already seated in a theatre may take the wing desk when it is free, and may drop the desk again at any time. A team holding the desk may take any free theatre, provided it is not already seated; taking the theatre releases the desk in the same step and clears that team's request. A theatre that is held may be freed as long as the cart is not docked in it. The cart may be docked into any theatre that is held, when the cart is not already docked somewhere. A theatre with the cart docked in it may power the beam, and a theatre with the beam on may switch it off. The cart may be undocked from a theatre once that theatre's beam is off. Teams are persistent: a team that keeps getting the chance to take the desk or a theatre eventually does, beams are always switched off, and carts and theatres are always eventually released.

SAFETY PROPERTY: A theatre may have its imaging beam on only if the shared cart is docked in that very theatre, so the beam is never live in two theatres at once.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every request raised by a team is eventually cleared, so no team waits at the desk forever.

---- MODULE W4Od5m3p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Peers, Players, MaxTerm, Cap, NoPeer

VARIABLES term, lead, own, sheet, lobby

vars == <<term, lead, own, sheet, lobby>>

\* Authority in the lobby is the current term, not the peer's identity. A peer
\* only writes to the match sheet while the term it is carrying is the live
\* one, and every line it writes is stamped with the term it carried.

Entry == [pl : Players, tm : 0..MaxTerm]

TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ lead \in Peers \cup {NoPeer}
  /\ own \in [Peers -> 0..MaxTerm]
  /\ sheet \in Seq(Entry)
  /\ lobby \subseteq Players

Init ==
  /\ term = 0
  /\ lead = NoPeer
  /\ own = [n \in Peers |-> 0]
  /\ sheet = << >>
  /\ lobby = {}

Join(p) ==
  /\ p \notin lobby
  /\ lobby' = lobby \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, lead, own, sheet>>

Leave(p) ==
  /\ p \in lobby
  /\ lobby' = lobby \ {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, lead, own, sheet>>

\* No peer ever dies here; a peer that is merely slow keeps running with the
\* term it last picked up, which is exactly how a stale writer appears.
Elect(n) ==
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ lead # n
  /\ term' = term + 1
  /\ lead' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<own, sheet, lobby>>

Adopt(n) ==
  /\ lead = n
  /\ own[n] # term
  /\ own' = [own EXCEPT ![n] = term]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, lead, sheet, lobby>>

Seat(n, p) ==
  /\ own[n] = term
  /\ p \in lobby
  /\ Len(sheet) < Cap
  /\ sheet' = Append(sheet, [pl |-> p, tm |-> own[n]])
  /\ lobby' = lobby \ {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, lead, own>>

Launch ==
  /\ Len(sheet) = Cap
  /\ sheet' = << >>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, lead, own, lobby>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Players : Join(p)
  \/ \E p \in Players : Leave(p)
  \/ \E n \in Peers : Elect(n)
  \/ \E n \in Peers : Adopt(n)
  \/ \E n \in Peers, p \in Players : Seat(n, p)
  \/ Launch

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Intent: the sheet reads forward in time. A slow peer writing under a term
\* the lobby has already moved past would show up as a line stamped older
\* than the line before it.
StampsNeverGoBackwards ==
  \A i \in 1..Len(sheet) :
    (i + 1) \in 1..Len(sheet) => sheet[i].tm =< sheet[i + 1].tm

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Peers = {peerA, peerB}
  Players = {gamer1, gamer2}
  MaxTerm = 2
  Cap = 3
  NoPeer = nopeer

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT StampsNeverGoBackwards
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker is run by a handful of peers, one of which is the elected host for the current term. Peers are never assumed to die: a peer that stops responding for a while is simply slow, and it keeps running with whatever term it last picked up. Authority therefore rests on the term a peer is carrying, not on the peer's name. The match sheet is an append-only list of seated players, and every line is stamped with the term its writer was carrying when it wrote.

A player who is not in the lobby may join it, and a player in the lobby may leave. While terms remain, any peer other than the sitting host may be elected: that advances the term and makes the new peer the host. A peer that is the host and is not yet carrying the live term may adopt it, taking the live term as its own. A peer whose carried term equals the live term may seat a lobby player onto the match sheet while the sheet is below its cap; the line it writes is stamped with the term that peer is carrying, and the player leaves the lobby. When the sheet is full, the match launches and the sheet is emptied for the next one.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Reading the match sheet from the front, the term stamps never decrease, so no slow peer writing under a superseded term can ever land a line behind a fresher one.

---- MODULE W4Od7m6p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Bays, Cranes, StackMax, MaxTTL, Cargo, NoBay

VARIABLES stack, lease, ttl, sealed, ship

vars == <<stack, lease, ttl, sealed, ship>>

\* A lease is a promise of one slot of headroom in a bay. Headroom is what is
\* rationed here, not exclusivity: several cranes may hold leases on the same
\* bay so long as the boxes already stacked plus the outstanding leases fit.

Booked(b) == Cardinality({c \in Cranes : lease[c] = b})

Filled(b) == stack[b] + Booked(b)

TypeOK ==
  /\ stack \in [Bays -> 0..StackMax]
  /\ lease \in [Cranes -> Bays \cup {NoBay}]
  /\ ttl \in [Cranes -> 0..MaxTTL]
  /\ sealed \in [Bays -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ ship \in 0..Cargo

Init ==
  /\ stack = [b \in Bays |-> 0]
  /\ lease = [c \in Cranes |-> NoBay]
  /\ ttl = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]
  /\ sealed = [b \in Bays |-> FALSE]
  /\ ship = Cargo

Grant(c, b) ==
  /\ lease[c] = NoBay
  /\ ~sealed[b]
  /\ Filled(b) < StackMax
  /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![c] = b]
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = MaxTTL]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stack, sealed, ship>>

Tick(c) ==
  /\ lease[c] # NoBay
  /\ ttl[c] > 0
  /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stack, lease, sealed, ship>>

\* An expired lease gives its headroom straight back; the crane must ask again.
Lapse(c) ==
  /\ lease[c] # NoBay
  /\ ttl[c] = 0
  /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![c] = NoBay]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stack, ttl, sealed, ship>>

Place(c) ==
  /\ lease[c] # NoBay
  /\ ttl[c] > 0
  /\ ship > 0
  /\ stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![lease[c]] = @ + 1]
  /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![c] = NoBay]
  /\ ship' = ship - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ttl, sealed>>

Seal(b) ==
  /\ ~sealed[b]
  /\ sealed' = [sealed EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stack, lease, ttl, ship>>

Unseal(b) ==
  /\ sealed[b]
  /\ sealed' = [sealed EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stack, lease, ttl, ship>>

\* The yard supervisor can drop a box into a sealed bay without a lease, but
\* even the override is measured against the same headroom.
Override(b) ==
  /\ ship > 0
  /\ Filled(b) < StackMax
  /\ stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1]
  /\ ship' = ship - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, sealed>>

Lift(b) ==
  /\ stack[b] > 0
  /\ ship < Cargo
  /\ stack' = [stack EXCEPT ![b] = @ - 1]
  /\ ship' = ship + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, ttl, sealed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Cranes, b \in Bays : Grant(c, b)
  \/ \E c \in Cranes : Tick(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cranes : Lapse(c)
  \/ \E c \in Cranes : Place(c)
  \/ \E b \in Bays : Seal(b)
  \/ \E b \in Bays : Unseal(b)
  \/ \E b \in Bays : Override(b)
  \/ \E b \in Bays : Lift(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Intent: boxes on the ground plus leases still outstanding never promise
\* more than a bay can physically stack, override included.
BayHeadroomHolds == \A b \in Bays : Filled(b) =< StackMax

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Bays = {bayNorth, baySouth}
  Cranes = {crane1, crane2}
  StackMax = 2
  MaxTTL = 2
  Cargo = 3
  NoBay = nobay

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT BayHeadroomHolds
nl:
A container-ship crane yard stacks boxes off a vessel into a small number of ground bays. Each bay can physically stack only so many boxes high. Cranes do not own bays exclusively; what they take out is a lease on one slot of headroom in a bay, and several cranes may hold leases on the same bay at once. A bay is considered full when the boxes already on the ground plus the leases still outstanding against it reach the stack limit. Every lease carries a time to live and dies when that runs out. The yard supervisor has an override that ignores leases and seals entirely.

A crane with no lease may be granted one on any bay that is not sealed and is not already full counting outstanding leases; the lease starts with a full time to live. A lease ticks down while it is held. A lease whose time to live has reached zero lapses, giving its headroom straight back without a box being placed. A crane holding a live lease may place a box: the bay's stack grows by one, the lease is given up, and one box comes off the vessel. The supervisor may seal a bay against new leases and may unseal it again. The supervisor's override drops a box straight into any bay, sealed or not and with no lease at all, but only while that bay still has headroom counting outstanding leases. Finally, a box may be lifted back off any non-empty bay and returned to the vessel while the vessel has room for it.

SAFETY PROPERTY: For every bay, the boxes on the ground plus the leases still outstanding against that bay never exceed the bay's stack limit.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m2p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Stations, Parties, MaxBallot, Shelf, NoStation

VARIABLES ballot, phase, held, ack, stock

vars == <<ballot, phase, held, ack, stock>>

\* Two dispensing stations run their own two-phase fills but draw from one
\* shelf. Each fill carries a ballot number; an acknowledgement is only worth
\* anything if it was given under the ballot the holding station is running.

Nxt(b) == IF b = MaxBallot THEN 1 ELSE b + 1

Owns(s) == {p \in Parties : held[p] = s}

TypeOK ==
  /\ ballot \in [Stations -> 0..MaxBallot]
  /\ phase \in [Stations -> {"idle", "prep", "ready"}]
  /\ held \in [Parties -> Stations \cup {NoStation}]
  /\ ack \in [Parties -> 0..MaxBallot]
  /\ stock \in 0..Shelf

Init ==
  /\ ballot = [s \in Stations |-> 0]
  /\ phase = [s \in Stations |-> "idle"]
  /\ held = [p \in Parties |-> NoStation]
  /\ ack = [p \in Parties |-> 0]
  /\ stock = Shelf

\* A station may only take a new ballot when it is holding nobody; otherwise
\* it would leave a party sitting on an acknowledgement nobody honours.
Open(s) ==
  /\ phase[s] = "idle"
  /\ Owns(s) = {}
  /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![s] = Nxt(@)]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "prep"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, ack, stock>>

Enlist(s, p) ==
  /\ phase[s] = "prep"
  /\ held[p] = NoStation
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = s]
  /\ ack' = [ack EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, phase, stock>>

Vote(s, p) ==
  /\ held[p] = s
  /\ phase[s] = "prep"
  /\ ack[p] # ballot[s]
  /\ ack' = [ack EXCEPT ![p] = ballot[s]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, phase, held, stock>>

Commit(s) ==
  /\ phase[s] = "prep"
  /\ Owns(s) = Parties
  /\ \A p \in Parties : ack[p] = ballot[s]
  /\ stock > 0
  /\ stock' = stock - 1
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "ready"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, held, ack>>

Abort(s) ==
  /\ phase[s] = "prep"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
  /\ held' = [p \in Parties |-> IF held[p] = s THEN NoStation ELSE held[p]]
  /\ ack' = [p \in Parties |-> IF held[p] = s THEN 0 ELSE ack[p]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, stock>>

Handover(s) ==
  /\ phase[s] = "ready"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
  /\ held' = [p \in Parties |-> IF held[p] = s THEN NoStation ELSE held[p]]
  /\ ack' = [p \in Parties |-> IF held[p] = s THEN 0 ELSE ack[p]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, stock>>

Restock ==
  /\ stock < Shelf
  /\ stock' = stock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, phase, held, ack>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Stations : Open(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations, p \in Parties : Enlist(s, p)
  \/ \E s \in Stations, p \in Parties : Vote(s, p)
  \/ \E s \in Stations : Commit(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations : Abort(s)
  \/ \E s \in Stations : Handover(s)
  \/ Restock

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ \A s \in Stations : WF_vars(Abort(s))
  /\ \A s \in Stations : WF_vars(Handover(s))

\* Intent: an acknowledgement on file always belongs to the ballot its holder
\* is running right now. A vote carried over from a superseded fill would
\* show up here as a mismatch.
AcksAreCurrent ==
  \A p \in Parties :
    (held[p] # NoStation /\ ack[p] # 0) => ack[p] = ballot[held[p]]

EnlistmentsRelease ==
  \A p \in Parties : (held[p] # NoStation) ~> (held[p] = NoStation)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Stations = {stnLeft, stnRight}
  Parties = {vault, chart}
  MaxBallot = 2
  Shelf = 2
  NoStation = nostation

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT AcksAreCurrent

PROPERTY EnlistmentsRelease
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser runs two independent dispensing stations that draw from one shared shelf of stock. Filling a prescription is a two-phase commit across the same set of parties -- the drug vault and the patient chart -- and each fill carries a ballot number. An acknowledgement from a party is only worth anything if it was given under the ballot the station holding that party is currently running; anything older is a stale voice and must not count.

An idle station that is holding no party may open a fill, which takes the next ballot number and puts the station into the prepare phase. A station in prepare may enlist any party that is not held by anyone, which clears that party's acknowledgement. A party held by a station in prepare may vote, recording that station's current ballot as its acknowledgement. A station in prepare that holds every party, with every party's acknowledgement matching its ballot, may commit: one unit comes off the shared shelf and the station moves to ready. A station in prepare may instead abort, dropping back to idle and releasing every party it holds along with their acknowledgements. A station that is ready hands the prescription over, dropping back to idle and likewise releasing its parties. The shelf may be restocked whenever it is below capacity. Neither station stalls forever: a station in prepare eventually aborts if it does not commit, and a ready station always completes the handover.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any party that is held and carries an acknowledgement carries one recorded under exactly the ballot its holding station is running.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every party that gets enlisted into a fill is eventually released again.

---- MODULE W4Od17m6p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Routers, Bags, MaxLife, NoRouter, NoBag

VARIABLES owner, life, feeding, belt, sorted

vars == <<owner, life, feeding, belt, sorted>>

\* One high-speed chute, handed out as a lease with a countdown. Routers are
\* slow, never dead, so an expired lease is reclaimed by waiting for the
\* holder to finish the bag in the chute rather than cutting it off.

Quiet == \A r \in Routers : feeding[r] = NoBag

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in Routers \cup {NoRouter}
  /\ life \in 0..MaxLife
  /\ feeding \in [Routers -> Bags \cup {NoBag}]
  /\ belt \subseteq Bags
  /\ sorted \subseteq Bags

Init ==
  /\ owner = NoRouter
  /\ life = 0
  /\ feeding = [r \in Routers |-> NoBag]
  /\ belt = {}
  /\ sorted = {}

Arrive(b) ==
  /\ b \notin belt
  /\ b \notin sorted
  /\ \A r \in Routers : feeding[r] # b
  /\ belt' = belt \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, life, feeding, sorted>>

Grant(r) ==
  /\ owner = NoRouter
  /\ owner' = r
  /\ life' = MaxLife
  /\ UNCHANGED <<feeding, belt, sorted>>

Countdown ==
  /\ life > 0
  /\ life' = life - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, feeding, belt, sorted>>

\* The reclaim waits for the chute to run empty; that wait is exactly what
\* keeps a slow holder from being overlapped by the next lease.
Reclaim ==
  /\ owner # NoRouter
  /\ life = 0
  /\ Quiet
  /\ owner' = NoRouter
  /\ UNCHANGED <<life, feeding, belt, sorted>>

Feed(r, b) ==
  /\ owner = r
  /\ life > 0
  /\ feeding[r] = NoBag
  /\ b \in belt
  /\ feeding' = [feeding EXCEPT ![r] = b]
  /\ belt' = belt \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, life, sorted>>

Clear(r) ==
  /\ feeding[r] # NoBag
  /\ sorted' = sorted \cup {feeding[r]}
  /\ feeding' = [feeding EXCEPT ![r] = NoBag]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, life, belt>>

Offload(b) ==
  /\ b \in sorted
  /\ sorted' = sorted \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, life, feeding, belt>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Bags : Arrive(b)
  \/ \E r \in Routers : Grant(r)
  \/ Countdown
  \/ Reclaim
  \/ \E r \in Routers, b \in Bags : Feed(r, b)
  \/ \E r \in Routers : Clear(r)
  \/ \E b \in Bags : Offload(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Intent: nobody but the current leaseholder ever has a bag in the chute,
\* so the chute is worked by one router at a time.
ChuteWorkedByOwner ==
  \A r \in Routers : (owner # r) => feeding[r] = NoBag

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Routers = {rtNorth, rtWest}
  Bags = {bagOne, bagTwo}
  MaxLife = 2
  NoRouter = norouter
  NoBag = nobag

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT ChuteWorkedByOwner
nl:
An airport baggage router feeds bags into one high-speed sorting chute. The right to feed that chute is handed out as a lease with a countdown: whoever holds the lease may push bags in until the countdown runs out. Routers here are slow but never dead -- a router can take a long time to push a bag through, but it will always get there -- so an expired lease is reclaimed by waiting for the chute to run empty, not by cutting the slow holder off mid-bag.

A bag that is not on the feeder belt, not already sorted, and not currently in the chute may arrive onto the belt. When no router holds the lease, the lease may be granted to any router with a full countdown. The countdown ticks down while it is above zero. Once the countdown has reached zero and no router has a bag in the chute, the lease is reclaimed and the chute goes ownerless. The router holding the lease, with countdown left and nothing already in the chute, may feed any bag from the belt into the chute. A router with a bag in the chute clears it, marking the bag sorted. A sorted bag may be offloaded and leaves the system.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No router other than the current leaseholder ever has a bag in the sorting chute, so the chute is only ever worked by one router at a time.

---- MODULE W4Od0m4p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Desks, Cases, QCap, Teams, MaxGen, NoCase

VARIABLES backlog, gen, auth, theatre, free

vars == <<backlog, gen, auth, theatre, free>>

\* Two booking desks run independently but share one pool of anaesthesia
\* teams; a team token is what a desk must hold to keep a case moving, and
\* the empty pool is the only thing that stops either desk booking more.

InPlay(c) ==
  \/ \E d \in Desks : theatre[d] = c
  \/ \E d \in Desks : \E i \in 1..Len(backlog[d]) : backlog[d][i] = c

TypeOK ==
  /\ backlog \in [Desks -> Seq(Cases)]
  /\ gen \in 0..MaxGen
  /\ auth \in [Desks -> 0..MaxGen]
  /\ theatre \in [Desks -> Cases \cup {NoCase}]
  /\ free \in 0..Teams

Init ==
  /\ backlog = [d \in Desks |-> << >>]
  /\ gen = 0
  /\ auth = [d \in Desks |-> 0]
  /\ theatre = [d \in Desks |-> NoCase]
  /\ free = Teams

Book(d, c) ==
  /\ auth[d] = gen
  /\ Len(backlog[d]) < QCap
  /\ free > 0
  /\ ~InPlay(c)
  /\ backlog' = [backlog EXCEPT ![d] = Append(@, c)]
  /\ free' = free - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, auth, theatre>>

Start(d) ==
  /\ auth[d] = gen
  /\ backlog[d] # << >>
  /\ theatre[d] = NoCase
  /\ theatre' = [theatre EXCEPT ![d] = Head(backlog[d])]
  /\ backlog' = [backlog EXCEPT ![d] = Tail(@)]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, auth, free>>

Close(d) ==
  /\ theatre[d] # NoCase
  /\ theatre' = [theatre EXCEPT ![d] = NoCase]
  /\ free' = free + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<backlog, gen, auth>>

Drop(d) ==
  /\ backlog[d] # << >>
  /\ backlog' = [backlog EXCEPT ![d] = Tail(@)]
  /\ free' = free + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, auth, theatre>>

\* Rotating the on-call roster hands over any theatre that is mid-case in the
\* same step; a desk that is idle is simply left holding an old authority.
Rotate ==
  /\ gen < MaxGen
  /\ gen' = gen + 1
  /\ auth' = [d \in Desks |->
                IF theatre[d] # NoCase THEN gen + 1 ELSE auth[d]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<backlog, theatre, free>>

Renew(d) ==
  /\ auth[d] # gen
  /\ theatre[d] = NoCase
  /\ auth' = [auth EXCEPT ![d] = gen]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<backlog, gen, theatre, free>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Desks, c \in Cases : Book(d, c)
  \/ \E d \in Desks : Start(d)
  \/ \E d \in Desks : Close(d)
  \/ \E d \in Desks : Drop(d)
  \/ Rotate
  \/ \E d \in Desks : Renew(d)

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ \A d \in Desks : WF_vars(Close(d))
  /\ \A d \in Desks : WF_vars(Renew(d))

\* Intent: a desk with a patient on the table is always carrying the live
\* roster authority -- an authority left over from a previous roster must
\* never be found attached to an occupied theatre.
NoStaleTheatre ==
  \A d \in Desks : theatre[d] # NoCase => auth[d] = gen

StaleDesksCatchUp ==
  \A d \in Desks : (auth[d] # gen) ~> (auth[d] = gen)

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Desks = {deskA, deskB}
  Cases = {caseP, caseQ}
  QCap = 2
  Teams = 2
  MaxGen = 2
  NoCase = nocase

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT NoStaleTheatre

PROPERTY StaleDesksCatchUp
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler runs two booking desks that work independently but draw anaesthesia teams from one shared pool. Each desk keeps its own bounded backlog of cases; a booking consumes a team token from the shared pool, and an empty pool is the only thing that stops either desk taking on more work. Authority to move cases comes from the on-call roster, which carries a generation number, and each desk carries the generation it last picked up.

A desk whose authority matches the live roster generation may book a case that is nowhere else in the system, provided its backlog is below its cap and a team token is free; booking takes the token. A desk whose authority is live may start the case at the head of its backlog if its theatre is empty. A desk with an occupied theatre may close the case, emptying the theatre and returning the team token to the shared pool. A desk may also drop the case at the head of its backlog, returning that token. Rotating the on-call roster advances the generation and, in the same step, hands the new authority to every desk that has a patient on the table; a desk whose theatre is empty is simply left holding the old authority. An idle desk holding an old authority may renew, picking up the live generation. Desks always finish: an occupied theatre is always eventually closed, and an idle desk holding an old authority always eventually renews it.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any desk with an occupied theatre is carrying the live roster generation, so no case is ever run under an authority the roster has already superseded.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every desk left holding an out-of-date roster authority eventually catches up to the live generation.

---- MODULE W4Od10m4p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Blocks, Trains, MaxSerial, QCap, NoBlock, NoTrain, NoAuth

VARIABLES serial, auth, occ, manual, queue

vars == <<serial, auth, occ, manual, queue>>

Ticket == [blk : Blocks, sn : 0..MaxSerial]
Route == [tr : Trains, blk : Blocks]

\* Every block carries a serial that is bumped whenever the interlocking is
\* reset; a movement authority quotes the serial it was cut against, so an
\* authority issued before a reset is worthless afterwards.

Somewhere(t) == \E b \in Blocks : occ[b] = t

TypeOK ==
  /\ serial \in [Blocks -> 0..MaxSerial]
  /\ auth \in [Trains -> Ticket \cup {NoAuth}]
  /\ occ \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {NoTrain}]
  /\ manual \in [Blocks -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ queue \in Seq(Route)

Init ==
  /\ serial = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
  /\ auth = [t \in Trains |-> NoAuth]
  /\ occ = [b \in Blocks |-> NoTrain]
  /\ manual = [b \in Blocks |-> FALSE]
  /\ queue = << >>

\* Route requests pile into a bounded book; a full book is simply refused,
\* which is how the interlocking pushes back on the timetable.
Request(t, b) ==
  /\ Len(queue) < QCap
  /\ auth[t] = NoAuth
  /\ \A i \in 1..Len(queue) : queue[i].tr # t
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, [tr |-> t, blk |-> b])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<serial, auth, occ, manual>>

Issue ==
  /\ queue # << >>
  /\ auth[Head(queue).tr] = NoAuth
  /\ occ[Head(queue).blk] = NoTrain
  /\ auth' = [auth EXCEPT ![Head(queue).tr] =
                [blk |-> Head(queue).blk, sn |-> serial[Head(queue).blk]]]
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<serial, occ, manual>>

Refuse ==
  /\ queue # << >>
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<serial, auth, occ, manual>>

Enter(t) ==
  /\ auth[t] # NoAuth
  /\ auth[t].sn = serial[auth[t].blk]
  /\ occ[auth[t].blk] = NoTrain
  /\ ~Somewhere(t)
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![auth[t].blk] = t]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<serial, auth, manual, queue>>

Exit(b) ==
  /\ occ[b] # NoTrain
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = NoTrain]
  /\ auth' = [auth EXCEPT ![occ[b]] = NoAuth]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<serial, manual, queue>>

Reset(b) ==
  /\ serial[b] < MaxSerial
  /\ occ[b] = NoTrain
  /\ serial' = [serial EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<auth, occ, manual, queue>>

\* Hand signalling: the signaller may wave a train into a block with no
\* authority at all, but the block stays flagged until the train is out.
Flag(b) ==
  /\ ~manual[b]
  /\ manual' = [manual EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<serial, auth, occ, queue>>

Unflag(b) ==
  /\ manual[b]
  /\ occ[b] = NoTrain
  /\ manual' = [manual EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<serial, auth, occ, queue>>

HandSignal(t, b) ==
  /\ manual[b]
  /\ occ[b] = NoTrain
  /\ ~Somewhere(t)
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = t]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<serial, auth, manual, queue>>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Request(t, b)
  \/ Issue
  \/ Refuse
  \/ \E t \in Trains : Enter(t)
  \/ \E b \in Blocks : Exit(b)
  \/ \E b \in Blocks : Reset(b)
  \/ \E b \in Blocks : Flag(b)
  \/ \E b \in Blocks : Unflag(b)
  \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : HandSignal(t, b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Intent: a train standing in a block is there either on hand signalling or
\* on an authority cut for that block against the serial the block is on now.
\* An authority from before a reset must never be found under a train.
NoTrainOnStaleAuthority ==
  \A b \in Blocks :
    occ[b] # NoTrain =>
      \/ manual[b]
      \/ /\ auth[occ[b]] # NoAuth
         /\ auth[occ[b]].blk = b
         /\ auth[occ[b]].sn = serial[b]

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Blocks = {blkNorth, blkSouth}
  Trains = {trnRed, trnBlue}
  MaxSerial = 1
  QCap = 2
  NoBlock = noblock
  NoTrain = notrain
  NoAuth = noauth

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT NoTrainOnStaleAuthority
nl:
A subway signalling block system controls which train may stand in which track block. Every block carries a serial number that is bumped whenever the interlocking for that block is reset. A movement authority quotes the block it covers and the serial it was cut against, so an authority issued before a reset is worthless afterwards. The signaller also has hand signalling, a privileged override that puts a train into a block with no authority at all.

Route requests pile into a bounded request book: a train with no authority and no request already in the book may add one while there is room, and a full book is simply refused, which is how the interlocking pushes back on the timetable. The head request is issued when its train still has no authority and the block it names is clear; the authority is cut against that block's current serial and the request leaves the book. The head request may instead be refused outright and dropped. A train may enter the block its authority names, provided the authority's serial still matches the block's serial, the block is clear, and the train is not already standing somewhere. A train may exit its block, which clears the block and tears up its authority. A block that is clear may have its interlocking reset, bumping its serial. The signaller may flag a block for hand signalling, may unflag it only once it is clear, and may hand-signal any train that is not already standing somewhere into a flagged clear block.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every occupied block either is flagged for hand signalling or holds a train whose authority names that block and quotes the serial the block is currently on.

---- MODULE W4Od18m2p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Locks, MaxRound, MaxWidth

VARIABLES round, seen, vote, decision, bolt, width

vars == <<round, seen, vote, decision, bolt, width>>

\* The hub polls every lock before a policy change lands. A lock's vote only
\* counts if the lock has caught up to the round the hub is polling; the mesh
\* radio can only carry so many locks at once, and that width moves at runtime.

Nxt(r) == IF r = MaxRound THEN 1 ELSE r + 1

Voters == {l \in Locks : vote[l]}

TypeOK ==
  /\ round \in 0..MaxRound
  /\ seen \in [Locks -> 0..MaxRound]
  /\ vote \in [Locks -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ decision \in {"idle", "polling", "commit", "abort"}
  /\ bolt \in [Locks -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ width \in 1..MaxWidth

Init ==
  /\ round = 0
  /\ seen = [l \in Locks |-> 0]
  /\ vote = [l \in Locks |-> FALSE]
  /\ decision = "idle"
  /\ bolt = [l \in Locks |-> FALSE]
  /\ width = 1

\* Opening a round tears down every vote from the previous one in the same
\* step; otherwise a vote cast under the old round would still be sitting there.
Open ==
  /\ decision = "idle"
  /\ round' = Nxt(round)
  /\ vote' = [l \in Locks |-> FALSE]
  /\ decision' = "polling"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<seen, bolt, width>>

Sync(l) ==
  /\ seen[l] # round
  /\ ~vote[l]
  /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![l] = round]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, vote, decision, bolt, width>>

Prepare(l) ==
  /\ decision = "polling"
  /\ seen[l] = round
  /\ ~vote[l]
  /\ Cardinality(Voters) < width
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![l] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, seen, decision, bolt, width>>

Commit ==
  /\ decision = "polling"
  /\ \A l \in Locks : vote[l]
  /\ decision' = "commit"
  /\ bolt' = [l \in Locks |-> ~bolt[l]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, seen, vote, width>>

Abort ==
  /\ decision = "polling"
  /\ decision' = "abort"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, seen, vote, bolt, width>>

Settle ==
  /\ decision \in {"commit", "abort"}
  /\ decision' = "idle"
  /\ vote' = [l \in Locks |-> FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, seen, bolt, width>>

Retune ==
  /\ width' \in (1..MaxWidth) \ {width}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, seen, vote, decision, bolt>>

Next ==
  \/ Open
  \/ \E l \in Locks : Sync(l)
  \/ \E l \in Locks : Prepare(l)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ Settle
  \/ Retune

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ WF_vars(Abort)
  /\ WF_vars(Settle)

\* Intent: a vote on the board was cast by a lock that had caught up to the
\* round being polled. A vote left over from a superseded round would show
\* up here as a voter whose last sync predates the current round.
NoStaleVoteCounted ==
  \A l \in Locks : vote[l] => seen[l] = round

RoundsAlwaysSettle == (decision = "polling") ~> (decision = "idle")

====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Locks = {frontDoor, backDoor}
  MaxRound = 2
  MaxWidth = 2

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT NoStaleVoteCounted

PROPERTY RoundsAlwaysSettle
nl:
A smart-home door lock network pushes deadbolt policy changes out from a hub using a two-phase commit across every lock in the house. Each change is polled under a round number. A lock only counts as a voter if it has caught up to the round the hub is polling; a vote left over from a superseded round is a stale voice and must not be on the board. The mesh radio also has a working width -- the number of locks it can hold in the prepare phase at once -- and that width is retuned while the system is running.

When the hub is idle it opens a round: the round number advances, every vote from the previous round is torn down in the same step, and the hub starts polling. A lock whose last sync does not match the current round, and which is not currently a voter, may sync itself up to the round. While the hub is polling, a lock that is synced to the round and not yet a voter may prepare, provided the number of current voters is below the mesh width. When every lock is a voter, the hub commits: the deadbolt state of every lock flips. The hub may instead abort the poll. After a commit or an abort the hub settles back to idle, tearing down the votes. The mesh width may be retuned to any other permitted value at any time. The hub never hangs: a poll that does not commit is always eventually aborted, and a decided round is always eventually settled.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every lock currently on the vote board has a last sync equal to the round the hub is polling, so no vote cast under a superseded round is ever counted.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every round the hub starts polling eventually settles back to idle.

---- MODULE W4Od12m9p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Services, Units, Orders, MaxEpoch, NoService, NoOrder

VARIABLES epoch, owner, ledger, view, waiting

vars == <<epoch, owner, ledger, view, waiting>>

\* Two allocation services keep their own ledgers over one shared fridge of
\* units. Which service may write a unit is decided by an ownership map that
\* is only ever redrawn under a fresh epoch, and only for an idle unit.

Booked(u) == \E a \in Services : ledger[a][u] # NoOrder

Taken(o) == \E a \in Services : \E u \in Units : ledger[a][u] = o

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ owner \in [Units -> Services \cup {NoService}]
  /\ ledger \in [Services -> [Units -> Orders \cup {NoOrder}]]
  /\ view \in [Services -> 0..MaxEpoch]
  /\ waiting \subseteq Orders

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ owner = [u \in Units |-> NoService]
  /\ ledger = [a \in Services |-> [u \in Units |-> NoOrder]]
  /\ view = [a \in Services |-> 0]
  /\ waiting = {}

\* Redrawing ownership is the only way a unit changes hands, and a unit that
\* is written up in anyone's ledger is off limits to the redraw.
Redraw(u, s) ==
  /\ ~Booked(u)
  /\ owner[u] # s
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![u] = s]
  /\ epoch' = IF epoch = MaxEpoch THEN epoch ELSE epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, view, waiting>>

Refresh(a) ==
  /\ view[a] # epoch
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![a] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, ledger, waiting>>

Order(o) ==
  /\ o \notin waiting
  /\ ~Taken(o)
  /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {o}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, ledger, view>>

Cancel(o) ==
  /\ o \in waiting
  /\ waiting' = waiting \ {o}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, ledger, view>>

Assign(a, u, o) ==
  /\ view[a] = epoch
  /\ owner[u] = a
  /\ ledger[a][u] = NoOrder
  /\ o \in waiting
  /\ ~Taken(o)
  /\ ledger' = [ledger EXCEPT ![a][u] = o]
  /\ waiting' = waiting \ {o}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, view>>

Transfuse(a, u) ==
  /\ ledger[a][u] # NoOrder
  /\ ledger' = [ledger EXCEPT ![a][u] = NoOrder]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, owner, view, waiting>>

Next ==
  \/ \E u \in Units, s \in Services : Redraw(u, s)
  \/ \E a \in Services : Refresh(a)
  \/ \E o \in Orders : Order(o)
  \/ \E o \in Orders : Cancel(o)
  \/ \E a \in Services, u \in Units, o \in Orders : Assign(a, u, o)
  \/ \E a \in Services, u \in Units : Transfuse(a, u)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Intent: the two ledgers can never disagree about a unit. If both services
\* have a unit written up, it has to be against the same order -- anything
\* else is the same bag of blood promised twice.
LedgersAgreeOnUnits ==
  \A u \in Units : \A a, b \in Services :
    (ledger[a][u] # NoOrder /\ ledger[b][u] # NoOrder)
      => ledger[a][u] = ledger[b][u]

====
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker is run by two independent allocation services -- one for the wards, one for the theatres -- that keep separate ledgers over one shared fridge of blood units. Which service may write up a given unit is fixed by an ownership map, and that map is only ever redrawn under a fresh epoch number. Each service carries the epoch its view was drawn from.

A unit may be redrawn to a different service only while no service has that unit written up in its ledger; redrawing advances the epoch until the epoch ceiling is reached, after which the map may still be redrawn but the epoch stands still. A service whose view epoch does not match the live epoch may refresh it. A clinical order that is not already waiting and is not already written up anywhere may be placed onto the waiting list, and a waiting order may be cancelled. A service whose view matches the live epoch may assign a unit it owns, which is not already written up in its own ledger, against a waiting order that is not written up anywhere; the order then leaves the waiting list. A written-up unit may be transfused, which clears that entry from the service's ledger.

SAFETY PROPERTY: For any unit that both services have written up, the two ledgers name the same order, so the same bag of blood is never promised to two different orders.

---- MODULE W4Od18m3p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Hubs, Locks, Budget, MaxTerm, NoHub

VARIABLES lead, term, awake, outbox, cand

vars == <<lead, term, awake, outbox, cand>>

\* The mesh can only keep so many radios lit at once. A queued command has
\* already booked its radio slot, so queued commands and lit locks are counted
\* against the same budget. The outbox is a bag: order of delivery is free.

Lit == {l \in Locks : awake[l]}

Load == Cardinality(Lit) + Cardinality(outbox)

Bump(t) == IF t = MaxTerm THEN 1 ELSE t + 1

TypeOK ==
  /\ lead \in Hubs \cup {NoHub}
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ awake \in [Locks -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ outbox \subseteq Locks
  /\ cand \in [Hubs -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ lead = NoHub
  /\ term = 0
  /\ awake = [l \in Locks |-> FALSE]
  /\ outbox = {}
  /\ cand = [h \in Hubs |-> FALSE]

Campaign(h) ==
  /\ lead = NoHub
  /\ ~cand[h]
  /\ cand' = [cand EXCEPT ![h] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lead, term, awake, outbox>>

Install(h) ==
  /\ lead = NoHub
  /\ cand[h]
  /\ lead' = h
  /\ term' = Bump(term)
  /\ cand' = [k \in Hubs |-> FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<awake, outbox>>

Depose ==
  /\ lead # NoHub
  /\ lead' = NoHub
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, awake, outbox, cand>>

\* The only place the budget is checked: nothing enters the outbox unless a
\* radio slot is free once lit locks and queued commands are both counted.
Enqueue(l) ==
  /\ lead # NoHub
  /\ l \notin outbox
  /\ ~awake[l]
  /\ Load < Budget
  /\ outbox' = outbox \cup {l}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lead, term, awake, cand>>

Deliver(l) ==
  /\ lead # NoHub
  /\ l \in outbox
  /\ ~awake[l]
  /\ outbox' = outbox \ {l}
  /\ awake' = [awake EXCEPT ![l] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lead, term, cand>>

Doze(l) ==
  /\ awake[l]
  /\ awake' = [awake EXCEPT ![l] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lead, term, outbox, cand>>

Scrap(l) ==
  /\ l \in outbox
  /\ outbox' = outbox \ {l}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lead, term, awake, cand>>

Campaigning == \E h \in Hubs : Campaign(h)
Installing == \E h \in Hubs : Install(h)

Next ==
  \/ Campaigning
  \/ Installing
  \/ Depose
  \/ \E l \in Locks : Enqueue(l)
  \/ \E l \in Locks : Deliver(l)
  \/ \E l \in Locks : Doze(l)
  \/ \E l \in Locks : Scrap(l)

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ WF_vars(Campaigning)
  /\ WF_vars(Installing)

\* Intent: lit radios plus commands still sitting in the outbox never run
\* past the mesh budget, however the hub post changes hands.
MeshWithinBudget == Load =< Budget

HubPostRefilled == (lead = NoHub) ~> (lead # NoHub)

====

CONSTANTS
  Hubs = {hubHall, hubLoft}
  Locks = {lockFront, lockBack, lockGarage}
  Budget = 2
  MaxTerm = 2
  NoHub = nohub

SPECIFICATION Spec

INVARIANT MeshWithinBudget

PROPERTY HubPostRefilled
nl:
A smart-home door lock network is driven by one elected hub at a time, with the other hubs standing by to take over. The mesh radio can only keep a limited number of lock radios lit at once, and a command sitting in the hub's outbox has already booked its radio slot, so lit locks and queued commands are counted against the same budget. The outbox is a bag rather than a queue: commands may be delivered in any order.

When the hub post is vacant, any hub that is not already a candidate may declare a campaign, and any candidate may then be installed, which fills the post, advances the term, and clears the candidate list. The sitting hub may be deposed at any time, leaving the post vacant. While a hub is in post it may enqueue a command for a lock that is neither already in the outbox nor already lit, but only while lit locks plus queued commands leave a free radio slot; this is the only place the budget is checked. A queued command for a lock that is not lit may be delivered, taking the command out of the outbox and lighting that lock. A lit lock may doze off, going dark. A queued command may also be scrapped without being delivered. Elections never stall: while the post is vacant, a campaign is always eventually declared and a candidate always eventually installed.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of lit lock radios plus the number of commands still in the outbox never exceeds the mesh budget.
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Whenever the hub post falls vacant it is eventually filled again.

---- MODULE W4Od8m8p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Students, Sections, MaxCycle, NoStudent, NoSection

VARIABLES cycle, carry, desk, seat, enrol

vars == <<cycle, carry, desk, seat, enrol>>

\* Clearance, not identity, is what lets a student touch registration. The
\* registrar's advising cycle moves, and a clearance carried from an older
\* cycle is worthless. Students are slow but never disappear, so the
\* registrar waits for the desk and the section holds to empty out.

Holding(t) == desk = t \/ \E s \in Sections : seat[s] = t

TypeOK ==
  /\ cycle \in 0..MaxCycle
  /\ carry \in [Students -> 0..MaxCycle]
  /\ desk \in Students \cup {NoStudent}
  /\ seat \in [Sections -> Students \cup {NoStudent}]
  /\ enrol \in [Students -> Sections \cup {NoSection}]

Init ==
  /\ cycle = 0
  /\ carry = [t \in Students |-> 0]
  /\ desk = NoStudent
  /\ seat = [s \in Sections |-> NoStudent]
  /\ enrol = [t \in Students |-> NoSection]

\* The cycle only rolls once every hold has been given back; a slow student
\* delays the roll rather than being cut out of it.
Roll ==
  /\ cycle < MaxCycle
  /\ desk = NoStudent
  /\ \A s \in Sections : seat[s] = NoStudent
  /\ cycle' = cycle + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<carry, desk, seat, enrol>>

Advise(t) ==
  /\ carry[t] # cycle
  /\ ~Holding(t)
  /\ carry' = [carry EXCEPT ![t] = cycle]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cycle, desk, seat, enrol>>

TakeDesk(t) ==
  /\ desk = NoStudent
  /\ carry[t] = cycle
  /\ enrol[t] = NoSection
  /\ desk' = t
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cycle, carry, seat, enrol>>

FreeDesk(t) ==
  /\ desk = t
  /\ desk' = NoStudent
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cycle, carry, seat, enrol>>

TakeSeat(t, s) ==
  /\ desk = t
  /\ carry[t] = cycle
  /\ seat[s] = NoStudent
  /\ seat' = [seat EXCEPT ![s] = t]
  /\ desk' = NoStudent
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cycle, carry, enrol>>

Register(t, s) ==
  /\ seat[s] = t
  /\ carry[t] = cycle
  /\ enrol[t] = NoSection
  /\ enrol' = [enrol EXCEPT ![t] = s]
  /\ seat' = [seat EXCEPT ![s] = NoStudent]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cycle, carry, desk>>

FreeSeat(t, s) ==
  /\ seat[s] = t
  /\ seat' = [seat EXCEPT ![s] = NoStudent]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cycle, carry, desk, enrol>>

Withdraw(t) ==
  /\ enrol[t] # NoSection
  /\ enrol' = [enrol EXCEPT ![t] = NoSection]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cycle, carry, desk, seat>>

Next ==
  \/ Roll
  \/ \E t \in Students : Advise(t)
  \/ \E t \in Students : TakeDesk(t)
  \/ \E t \in Students : FreeDesk(t)
  \/ \E t \in Students, s \in Sections : TakeSeat(t, s)
  \/ \E t \in Students, s \in Sections : Register(t, s)
  \/ \E t \in Students, s \in Sections : FreeSeat(t, s)
  \/ \E t \in Students : Withdraw(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Intent: whoever is standing at the registration desk, and whoever is
\* holding a section open, is carrying clearance from the cycle the
\* registrar is running right now -- never from a cycle already closed.
NoStaleHolder ==
  /\ desk # NoStudent => carry[desk] = cycle
  /\ \A s \in Sections :
       seat[s] # NoStudent => carry[seat[s]] = cycle

====
